encounter.encounter: Blood Knight / Crimson Knight / Bitter Knight
encounter.notes: Humanoid vampiric knight. A-pose, pale sinewy flesh, grey plate pauldrons/helm/greaves, deep red tabard front and back, clawed hands and digitigrade clawed feet. ONE build serves three encounter names through per-instance tint; base plate median is #696264 (near-neutral steel), so build neutral and let instanceColor multiply toward warm red (Crimson) and cold steel-blue (Bitter).

reference.closeup_policy: Deliberately none. This is the 512px trash profile, not the 1024px boss profile. The base plates carry a 676/674px subject, so they already oversample a 512 atlas by ~1.3x; a registered closeup can only add detail the atlas cannot hold. The set does publish usable closeups (view-04/05 helm front, view-06 helm back, view-07 torso front, view-09/10 legs) and they should be revisited only if this asset is ever promoted to the boss profile.
reference.orientation_verified: 2026-09-07, by eye on a side-by-side crop (_advice-crops/bk-pair.jpg): view-01 shows the face inside the helm opening, the front chest plate and forward-pointing foot claws; view-03 shows the helm's rear vent, the back plate and the heels. Gallery display order matches the front/back convention for this set.

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from build/bloodknight/plates/{front,back}-geometry.png (720x720). Draft: 422,292 faces in 69.1s on an RTX 4070 Ti Super. TRASH triangle budget 5,000 target / 6,000 max, not the 45-70k boss budget: trash can put dozens of these on screen at once.

regions.note: Shoulder detector: 0.8447 front, 0.8423 back; front used. Verified by eye on _advice-crops/bloodknight-plates.jpg - the line lands on the top of the pauldrons, so the band above it is helm only.
